+// ConsistentHashHeader defines a hash policy based on an HTTP request header.

+// ConsistentHashRegexRewrite specifies how to rewrite a header value using a regular expression.

+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string for the matched pattern.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookie defines a hash policy based on an HTTP cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookie struct {
+	// Name of the cookie that will be used to obtain the hash key.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the time-to-live for the cookie if generated by Envoy.
+	// Accepts Go duration format (e.g. "1h30m") or plain integer seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	TTL string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path is the path attribute for the cookie if generated by Envoy.
+	// +optional
+	Path string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes are additional cookie attributes passed through to Envoy.
+	// +optional
+	Attributes []ConsistentHashCookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set to true, will cause Envoy to short-circuit hash calculation if this policy produces a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// UnmarshalJSON unmarshals ConsistentHashCookie supporting string, number, or duration for ttl.
+func (c *ConsistentHashCookie) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
+	type Alias ConsistentHashCookie
+	aux := struct {
+		TTL any `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+		*Alias
+	}{
+		Alias: (*Alias)(c),
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &aux); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	switch v := aux.TTL.(type) {
+	case string:
+		c.TTL = v
+	case float64:
+		c.TTL = strconv.FormatInt(int64(v), 10)
+	case json.Number:
+		c.TTL = v.String()
+	case nil:
+		c.TTL = ""
+	default:
+		return fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl: %v", aux.TTL)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookieAttribute defines an attribute for a generated cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name of the cookie attribute.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value of the cookie attribute.
+	// +optional
+	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashQueryParameter defines a hash policy based on a URL query parameter.
+type ConsistentHashQueryParameter struct {
+	// Name of the URL query parameter that will be used to obtain the hash key.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set to true, will cause Envoy to short-circuit hash calculation if this policy produces a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashFilterState defines a hash policy based on an object in the filter state.
+type ConsistentHashFilterState struct {
+	// Key is the name of the object in the filter state.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set to true, will cause Envoy to short-circuit hash calculation if this policy produces a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashSourceIP defines a hash policy based on the downstream source IP address.
+type ConsistentHashSourceIP struct {
+	// Terminal, if set to true, will cause Envoy to short-circuit hash calculation if this policy produces a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+type ConsistentHashSourceIp = ConsistentHashSourceIP
